section: You seem to know a lot

conversation.speaker: dialogue
conversation.text:
Police: You seem to know quite a lot about Xiyuan’s family.
Respondent: Minghao’s family—I’m indeed quite familiar with them. After all, I’ve known them since they were very young.
Respondent: It’s been... three or four years, I suppose...
Respondent: When Minghao’s family first moved into this residential complex, the first time I saw him, I thought he was an upper-grade elementary school student.
Respondent: Compared to children of the same age, he’s very tall and doesn’t talk much.
Respondent: At that time, Minghao’s mother wanted to buy some school supplies, so I recommended some items used by upper-grade students.
Respondent: I remember Minghao’s mother smiling and saying that Minghao is often misunderstood like that.
Respondent: I don’t know if you’ve met him. Minghao is...
Respondent: Although he is young, he is very mature and steady.
Respondent: Children his age must have many things they want to buy, but every time he stands behind his younger sister and helps her pick the things she likes.
